LESSON: WRITING 6.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do pictures make you feel?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. organise pictures in a logical sequence to write pictorial compositions of about 60-80 words on the theme,
2. write a pictorial composition of about 60 - 80 words on the theme for effective communication,
3. adopt the use of a wide range of pictures to write pictorial compositions on different topics for communication. The learner is guided to: offline sources collaboratively, sources to write a pictorial composition of 60 - 80 words based on the theme, write pictorial compositions of about 60 - 80 words, the theme and write pictorial compositions collaboratively, from the internet and write pictorial composition. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing.
2. Explain Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: discuss pictures collaboratively and write pictorial compositions of about 60 - 80 words,
4. Show that you can: organise pictures in a logical sequence to write pictorial compositions of about 60-80 words on the theme,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do pictures make you feel?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
